guard.attacks_blocked.why: every adversarial query in golden_guard.json must be rejected before it reaches DuckDB

guard.legitimate_allowed.why: a guard that rejects real analytics questions pushes the repair loop into worse SQL

guard.row_caps_enforced.why: no generated query may return more than the row cap

routing_keyword.accuracy.why: the keyword router is the fallback when Ollama is down; measured 19/20

routing_keyword.worst_tool_recall.why: a router that collapses one tool onto another looks fine on accuracy alone

references.runnable.why: every golden reference query must pass the guard and execute; a schema change breaks them first

models.wp_auc.why: measured 0.863 on 2021-2024; above 0.95 on held-out seasons means a leaked feature

models.wp_log_loss.why: measured 0.455; the full-split model matches nflfastR's vegas_wp

models.wp_ece.why: the fourth-down advisor compares probabilities directly, so they must be calibrated

models.wp_log_loss_gap_vs_vegas.why: stay within reach of nflfastR's own model scored on the same held-out plays

models.playcall_auc.why: measured 0.815; run/pass from pre-snap state tops out well below 0.92 without leakage

models.playcall_lift_over_majority.why: the play-call model must beat always guessing pass by a real margin; measured +0.12

models.advisor_agreement.why: measured 0.67; far below that the advisor is disagreeing with coaches on obvious punts

models.advisor_go_rate.why: measured 0.42; outside this band the advisor has collapsed to always or never going for it

text_to_sql.runnable.why: measured 15/15 with qwen2.5-coder:7b; guarded SQL that fails to run is a wasted answer

text_to_sql.correct.why: execution accuracy on the development set; measured 14/15 with qwen2.5-coder:7b (7/15 before tuning)

text_to_sql.holdout_correct.why: held-out questions never used for tuning; measured 9/15 (3/15 before). The number to quote

routing_llm.accuracy.why: the LLM router must at least match the keyword fallback; measured 19/20

routing_llm.worst_tool_recall.why: per-tool recall, as for the keyword router

retrieval.hit_at_1.why: measured 0.94 hybrid hit@1 on the retrieval golden set

retrieval.hybrid_mrr_gain.why: hybrid must not lose to dense or lexical alone, or the fusion is not earning its cost
